description: I support ShiftQuest Africa’s branding and communication efforts by designing social media content, event graphics, promotional materials, and campaign visuals while helping maintain a consistent and professional brand identity.

Supported data analysis and statistical activities within the club.
Contributed to marketing and promotion of club initiatives and activities.
Participated in organizing and coordinating community events, outreach programs, and student engagements.
Managed and created content for the club's Instagram account, supporting digital engagement and visibility.
Assisted in communicating data-related and economic/statistical concepts to students and the wider community.
Collaborated with other ambassadors and club leadership to promote events and initiatives.
